instruction: A candid documentary wide shot of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls. On the left, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands upright, facing right with a neutral expression. On the right, the man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) leans his torso back on his left leg, executing a high side kick with his right leg directly towards her hip. The two interact as his foot makes light contact with her side. The studio is brightly lit by overhead lights, casting soft shadows on the red floor, with motion capture cameras visible in the background.
elements: R1 executes a high side kick toward R2's hip
R1's foot makes light contact with R2's side
R2 stands upright receiving the side contact from R1's kick
R1 leans his torso back on his left leg while kicking
R2 faces R1 during the interaction
indoor motion capture studio with red carpet, white walls, and visible motion capture cameras
